review_improvement: Preserves the replay-specific stimulus and corrected CPER fields while adding mode discrimination, secure attribution, artifact integrity and proof that replay activity stops.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type4 differentiates replay behavior from the type2 case at the same address, so command success and generic UMC evidence cannot identify the intended mode. Subtype2, UMC bank, ext0, HBMEccErr and corrected severity must align in one attributable CPER. Because replay can imply repeated presentation of an error, a bounded quiet window and stable counters are part of safe recovery. The event must never be silently reclassified as uncorrectable from generic review text.
